design_description: A bold Paris-inspired design built on a vivid red base with contrasting royal-blue sleeves and collar. A large tonal Eiffel Tower runs vertically through the centre, creating a strong city identity without overpowering the kit. Blue sleeves are finished with red cuffs, tying the two primary colours together cleanly. White branding and sponsor graphics provide sharp contrast, while navy-and-gold crest details add a more premium accent. Overall, a clean modern tribute to Paris built around the iconic Eiffel Tower silhouette.
